found_by: checker golive-launch-prep cycle 0, coordinator A (P1) and coordinator B (P1)
title: The route-existence control counts any answer other than 404 or a network failure as 'route exists'. A 401 from a wrong or revoked operator key, or a 5xx, reads as proven, so a typo'd POST path could pass vacuously. Only the 404 case is tested.
fix_direction: Require the control to be a 2xx or 400-class answer, and add a wrong-key test.

title: The logout request's own status is not asserted by any test: replacing its pass condition with `true` leaves 18/18 green, because the stub logout always returns 200.
fix_direction: Stub a failing logout and assert that the step FAILs.

title: A 403 from a missing CSRF proof, or a 401 from an expired session, reads as a role refusal on the viewer steps; the detail prints only the status.
fix_direction: Re-check the session before the refusal steps, or print the error code.

title: preflight.json and summary.md write the --base/--api/--web values verbatim, so URL userinfo would be written; the mongoUrl redaction stops at the first '@'; --key is accepted on argv. None of this touches the new credential path.
fix_direction: Strip URL userinfo before writing; refuse --key on argv the way --password is refused.

title: The 'only unsafe calls' assertion filters on the method prefix, so the operator-key control `KEY POST /ingest` (empty body) is outside it. It is safe today (ingest answers 400 before any write, routes/ingest.ts:29-33), but the no-data-changing-call line of L1-C6 is not asserted for control requests.
fix_direction: Include the control requests in the assertion and allow only the empty-body POST /ingest.

title: The M check ran about 30 min wall, past the 10 min hard checkpoint; the slow step was building a separate baseline checkout and measuring per-test names and both baseline reds (about 14 min).
fix_direction: For a move-only unit, have the maker record the per-test name list at the base in the manifest so the checker only re-measures head.

title: The manifest has no Capability coverage table and no falsification lines (mutations=0), so the checker authored the falsification rows itself.
fix_direction: Record one falsification per criterion in the manifest at ready-for-check.

title: No test pins the apiPass keyed-path return value (askJobsDelta) or its ctx inputs (mongoOk, preflight, SKIP_ASK); only a closed-port run exercises it. The same gap existed before the move.
fix_direction: Add a stubbed-db test of apiPass if the keyed layer is relied on.
